_meta.description: sCure central Error Registry — the single source of truth for every error/warning. Each record has a stable, unique numeric code whose FIRST DIGIT identifies the SRS section/screen the error is documented in (3=Setup, 4=Setup Name, 5=Connect Organization, 6=Home, 7=Cure Process, 8=Cure History, 9=Error Management: device/hardware alerts + cross-cutting system faults). The code is carried UNCHANGED across every layer (C++ driver/daemon -> Flask backend -> React UI); the originating subsystem is recorded in the per-record "layer" field. CS may edit message, description, troubleshooting and supportUrl; code, key, severity, category and layer are system-defined.

ranges.label: Home Screen (material list, recipe builder, CSV import, view-all, start cure)
Error Management — device/hardware alerts (9001-9079) + cross-cutting system/backend faults (9080-9099)

errors.description: The system could not verify its serial number during setup. Setup cannot continue until the serial number is restored
troubleshooting: Restart the system
Run the setup process again
Make sure any installation media provided with the system is connected. Refer to the Product Guide for instructions on locating the installation media
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The system could not connect to the sCure cloud service during setup. Setup cannot continue until the connection is restored.
troubleshooting: Verify that the Ethernet cable is connected securely.
Confirm that your network has an active internet connection.
Open Network Status from the network icon (globe icon in the top-right corner) and verify that the system has an active network connection.
If needed, ask your IT administrator to use the DIAGNOSTICS tab tool to verify network connectivity and DNS settings.
Refer to the Product Guide for network setup requirements.
Run the setup process again.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The system is not connected to the internet. Setup cannot continue until the network connection is restored.
troubleshooting: Verify that the Ethernet cable is connected securely.
Confirm that your network has an active internet connection.
Open Network Status from the network icon (globe icon in the top-right corner) and verify that the system has an active network connection.
If needed, ask your IT administrator to use the Diagnostics tools to verify network connectivity and DNS settings.
Retry the setup process after the network connection is restored.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: A device name is required to continue setup. Enter a device name and try again.
troubleshooting: Enter a name for the device.
Make sure the device name contains at least one letter or number.
Continue with the setup process.

errors.description: The system could not save required data. Your changes or process information may not have been saved correctly.
troubleshooting: Restart the system.
Repeat the action that triggered the error.
Verify that the material, process, or history entry was added and saved correctly.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The system configuration was saved successfully, but a backup copy could not be created. System operation can continue.
troubleshooting: Restart the system.
If the warning appears again, verify that any service storage media provided with the system is installed correctly. Refer to the Product Guide for storage media location information.
If the warning persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The selected organization CSV file does not contain a valid Organization ID (UUID) and cannot be imported.
troubleshooting: Verify that the selected file is the organization CSV file exported from the portal.
Open the CSV file and confirm that it contains a valid Organization ID (UUID).
If the Organization ID is missing or invalid, export a new organization CSV file from the portal.
Import the updated CSV file.
If you do not want to import an organization at this time, continue the setup process without importing a CSV file.

errors.description: A program name is required before the recipe can be saved.
troubleshooting: Enter a program name.
Save the recipe again.

errors.description: At least one step is required before the recipe can be saved.
troubleshooting: Add at least one step to the recipe.
Save the recipe again.

errors.description: An N₂ purge step must be followed by a Cure or Bleaching step, and then a Cooling step.
troubleshooting: After the N₂ purge step, add a Cure or Bleaching step.
After the Cure or Bleaching step, add a Cooling step.
Save the recipe again.

errors.description: The temperature of a process step is lower than the previous step. Temperature decreases are only allowed in a Cooling step.
troubleshooting: Increase the step temperature to match or exceed the previous step's temperature.
If a temperature reduction is required, add a Cooling step before the lower-temperature step.
Save the recipe again.

errors.description: A Cooling step must have a target temperature lower than the previous step's temperature.
troubleshooting: Set the Cooling step target temperature below the previous step's temperature.
Save the recipe again.

errors.description: The selected program CSV file is missing required column headers or does not contain any program steps.
troubleshooting: Use a CSV file that was exported from the recipe builder.
Verify that all required column headers are present in the CSV file.
Verify that the CSV file contains at least one program step.
Import the CSV file again.

errors.description: The imported CSV file contains an unrecognized process name. Only Heating, Drying, Cure, Bleaching, Cooling, and Nitrogen processes are supported.
troubleshooting: Review the CSV file and locate any invalid process names.
Replace the invalid process name with a supported process type: Heating, Drying, Cure, Bleaching, Cooling, or Nitrogen.
If needed, export a new CSV file from the recipe builder and use it as a reference.
Import the CSV file again.

errors.description: The imported CSV file contains a temperature value outside the allowed range for the selected process step.
troubleshooting: Review the temperature value in the affected CSV row.
Set the temperature between 30°C and 80°C for Heating, Drying, Cure, Bleaching, and Nitrogen steps.
Set the temperature between 20°C and 75°C for Cooling steps.
Import the CSV file again.

errors.description: The imported CSV file contains a time value outside the allowed range.
troubleshooting: Review the time value in the affected CSV row.
Set the time between 1 and 120 minutes for standard process steps.
Set the Bleaching step time between 1 and 720 minutes.
If the CSV file was created manually or from an older system version, export a new CSV file from the current recipe builder and use it instead.
Import the CSV file again.

errors.description: The imported CSV file contains more than the allowed maximum of 2 Nitrogen purge steps.
troubleshooting: Review the program and identify all Nitrogen purge steps.
Remove or combine Nitrogen purge steps until no more than 2 remain in the program.
Save or export the updated program.
Import the CSV file again.

errors.description: The program CSV could not be saved to the USB drive. A copy of the file was downloaded through the browser instead.
troubleshooting: Locate and use the CSV file that was downloaded through the browser.
If you need to save the file directly to a USB drive, verify that a writable USB drive is connected.
Export the program again.

errors.description: A Cure Together batch can only include prints that use the same material. Prints with different materials were selected.
troubleshooting: Select only prints that use the same material for the Cure Together batch.
Create separate Cure Together batches for prints that use different materials.

errors.description: No material or print was selected. Select a material or print before starting a cure.
troubleshooting: Select a material or a recent print.
Start the cure again.

errors.description: The selected program requires Nitrogen, but Nitrogen is currently disabled in system settings.
troubleshooting: Enable Nitrogen in Settings.
Alternatively, select a program that does not rely solely on Nitrogen steps.
Start the program again.

errors.description: The system detected an issue that prevents the curing process from starting. Resolve the issue and try again.
troubleshooting: Review any active warnings or notifications displayed on the screen.
Verify that the door is fully closed.
Open the Settings page by selecting the Settings icon (gear icon) in the top-right corner, then run the available component diagnostics and resolve any reported issues
Restart the curing process.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The curing process was stopped because the door was opened during operation. Close the door and restart the process.
troubleshooting: Verify that the chamber door is fully closed.
Check that no trays, parts, or other objects are preventing the door from closing completely.
Restart the curing process.
If the issue persists while the door remains closed, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The requested target temperature is outside the allowed range for the selected cure step. The cure could not be started.
troubleshooting: Review the target temperature configured for the cure step.
Set the temperature between 30°C and 80°C for heating steps.
Set the temperature between 20°C and 80°C for cooling steps.
If the temperature was imported from a CSV file, correct the value and re-import the file.
Start the cure again.

errors.description: The requested UV intensity is outside the allowed range for the selected cure step. The cure could not be started.
troubleshooting: Review the UV intensity configured for the Cure or Bleaching step.
Set the UV intensity between 10% and 100%.
If the UV intensity was imported from a CSV file, correct the value and re-import the file.
Start the cure again.

errors.description: The selected cooling mode is not valid for the cooling step. The cure could not be started.
troubleshooting: Review the cooling mode configured for the cooling step.
Set the cooling mode to Fast, Medium, or Slow.
If the cooling mode was imported from a CSV file, correct the value and re-import the file.
Start the cure again.

errors.description: The chamber temperature is not moving toward the target temperature. Continuing the cure may affect cure quality and final part properties.
troubleshooting: Select Abort to stop the cure, or Continue if you choose to proceed despite the warning.
If the chamber is not heating, verify that the voltage selector next to the mains inlet is fully set to the correct 110 V or 220 V position for your local power source.
Verify that the chamber door is fully closed and sealing correctly.
Select the Settings icon (gear icon) in the upper right corner of the screen, then open Diagnostics and run the available diagnostics. Follow any corrective actions identified by the diagnostics.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The cure was aborted before completion. The system has returned to the Home screen.
troubleshooting: Insert a USB drive, open Cure History, select the aborted cure, and export the cure report for review.
Review the exported report to determine why the cure was aborted.
If the cure was aborted due to a warning or issue, resolve the cause before restarting the cure.
Start the cure again when ready.

If the cure aborts again or the cause cannot be determined from the report, contact Stratasys Support and provide the exported cure report and log files. To export the log files, insert a USB drive, select the Settings icon (gear icon) in the upper right corner of the screen, and then select Export Logs.

errors.description: The system cannot verify the chamber temperature. For safety reasons, the curing process has been stopped.
troubleshooting: Restart the system.
Verify that the chamber is empty and that nothing is blocking the internal airflow.
Start the curing process again.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.message: Fan Below Minimum Speed - System Stopped
errors.description: The system detected that a required cooling fan is not operating correctly. For safety reasons, the curing process has been stopped. The affected fan is identified above
troubleshooting: Identify the affected fan listed above
Check that nothing is blocking the fan or restricting airflow.
Restart the system.
Open the Settings page by selecting the Settings icon (gear icon) in the top-right corner, then run the available component diagnostics and resolve any reported issues.
If the issue persists, replace the Fan Assembly. Refer to the Repair Guide chapter in the Product Guide for Fan Assembly replacement instructions.
If the issue remains after replacing the Fan Assembly, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.message: Cooling Fan Not Spinning - Job Not Started
errors.description: The system detected that a required cooling fan is not operating. For safety reasons, the curing process cannot start. The affected fan is identified above.
troubleshooting: Identify the affected fan listed above.
Check that nothing is blocking the fan or preventing it from spinning.
Restart the system.
Open the Settings page by selecting the Settings icon (gear icon) in the top-right corner, then run the available component diagnostics and resolve any reported issues.
If the issue persists, replace the Fan Assembly. Refer to the Repair Guide chapter in the Product Guide for Fan Assembly replacement instructions.

errors.message: LED Panel Not Heating - Check LED Connection
errors.description: The system detected that an LED panel is not operating correctly. The curing process may not perform as expected until the issue is resolved. The affected LED panel is identified above.
troubleshooting: Identify the affected LED panel listed above.
Restart the system.

Restart the system and check whether the warning clears.
If the warning persists, contact Stratasys Support.
If requested by Stratasys Support, export the system log files. Insert a USB drive, select the Settings icon (gear icon) in the upper right corner of the screen, and then select Export Logs.

errors.description: A fan is operating below its expected speed and may be wearing out. The system can continue operating, but the fan should be inspected and replaced if the condition persists.
troubleshooting: Identify the fan named in the warning message.
Inspect the fan and air inlet/outlet areas for dust or debris and clean them if necessary.
Restart the system and check whether the warning clears.
If the warning persists, schedule replacement of the affected fan. Refer to the Repair Guide chapter in the Product Guide for fan replacement instructions.
If assistance is required, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The NFC reader is not detected. NFC cannot be enabled until a compatible NFC reader is connected and recognized by the system.
troubleshooting: Connect the NFC reader to a USB port on the machine.
Verify that you are using a data-capable USB cable. Charge-only USB cables are not supported.
Wait at least 5 seconds for the NFC reader to be detected.
Enable NFC again.
If the NFC reader is still not detected, restart the system and try again.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.message: Heater Fan Speed Low - Replace Fan
errors.description: The Chamber Fan Assembly is operating below its expected speed and may be wearing out. The system can continue operating, but the Chamber Fan Assembly should be inspected and replaced if the condition persists.
troubleshooting: Verify that the Chamber Fan air inlet and outlet are free of dust or debris.
If accessible, inspect the Chamber Fan for dust buildup and clean it if necessary.
Restart the system and check whether the warning clears.
If the warning persists, replace the Chamber Fan Assembly. Refer to the Repair Guide chapter in the Product Guide for Chamber Fan Assembly replacement instructions.
If the issue persists after replacing the Chamber Fan Assembly, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.message: Cooling Fan Speed Low - Replace Fan
errors.description: The LED Cooling Airflow system is operating below its expected speed and may be wearing out. The system can continue operating, but the affected component should be inspected and replaced if the condition persists.
troubleshooting: Verify that nothing is blocking the LED Cooling Airflow system or restricting airflow.
Inspect the air inlet and outlet areas for dust or debris and clean them if necessary.
Restart the system.
Open the Settings page by selecting the Settings icon (gear icon) in the top-right corner, then run the LED Cooling Airflow diagnostic test and verify the warnings has cleared.
If the warning persists, refer to the Repair Guide chapter in the Product Guide for LED Cooling Airflow repair instructions and replace the affected component.
If the issue remains after completing the repair procedure, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The selected network diagnostic tool is not supported.
troubleshooting: Select the Network icon (globe icon) in the upper right corner of the screen, open Diagnostics, and select a supported network diagnostic tool: Ping, Traceroute, or NSLookup.

Run the selected network diagnostic tool. These tools are primarily intended for IT administrators or advanced users to troubleshoot network connectivity issues. Please refer to your IT representative if applicable.
Retry the network operation.
If the issue persists, restart the system and try again.
If the issue continues, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: No USB drive was detected. Connect a USB drive and try the operation again.
troubleshooting: Insert a USB drive into the USB port on the machine.
Wait at least 5 seconds for the USB drive to be detected by the system.
Retry the export/upload operation.
If the USB drive is still not detected, try a different USB port (if applicable) or a different USB drive.
If the issue persists, restart the system and try again.
If the issue continues, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: A USB drive was detected, but the file could not be saved. The USB drive may be full, write-protected, or disconnected during the operation.
troubleshooting: Verify that the USB drive has available free space and is not write-protected.
Ensure the USB drive remains connected until the export/upload operation is complete.
Retry the export operation.
If the issue persists, back up any required files and reformat the USB drive using the FAT32 file system.
If the export/upload still fails, try a different USB drive.
If the issue continues, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The system could not export the log files to the USB drive.
troubleshooting: Insert a USB drive into one the USB port on the machine.
Verify that the USB drive has available free space and is not write-protected.
Select the Settings icon (gear icon) in the upper right corner of the screen, then select Export Logs and try again.
If the log export still fails, try a different USB drive.
Restart the system and try exporting the log files again.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The system could not retrieve its network status information.
troubleshooting: Verify that the Ethernet cable is securely connected to both the sCure system and the network outlet or switch.
Check that the Ethernet port link/activity LEDs are illuminated or blinking.
Restart the system.
Select the Network icon (globe icon) in the upper right corner of the screen and verify that the network settings are configured correctly.

errors.description: The selected network diagnostic could not be completed.
troubleshooting: Verify that the destination address entered for the network diagnostic is correct and reachable.
Select the Network icon (globe icon) in the upper right corner of the screen, open Diagnostics, and run the selected network diagnostic tool again.
Verify that the Ethernet cable is securely connected to both the sCure system and the network outlet or switch.
Restart the system and repeat the network diagnostic.

errors.description: The software update could not be completed successfully. The system software may not have been updated.
troubleshooting: Restart the system.
If performing an update from USB, verify that the USB drive is connected properly and contains the correct software update package, or replace the USB drive.
Retry the software update from the Update Software page.
If the issue persists, obtain a new copy of the software update package and try again.
If the issue remains, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: No valid software update package was found on the connected USB drive.
troubleshooting: Verify that the correct sCure software update package was copied to the USB drive.
Verify that all files provided with the software update package, including the package manifest file, were copied to the root directory of the USB drive.
Remove and reconnect the USB drive.
If the update package is still not found, try a different USB drive, or a different USB port (if applicable).
Retry the software update.
If the update package is missing or incomplete, obtain a new software update package from Stratasys and copy it to the USB drive again.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The software update package could not be verified and was not installed. For security reasons, the update has been blocked.
troubleshooting: If performing an update from USB, verify that the USB drive is connected properly and contains the correct software update package, or replace the USB drive.
Obtain a new copy of the software update package from the Stratasys Support Center or your authorized Stratasys representative.
Retry the software update from the Update Software page.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.

errors.description: The system cannot communicate with the hardware controller. Hardware operations cannot continue until communication is restored.
troubleshooting: Shut down the system and disconnect the power cord.
Wait 20 minutes.
Reconnect the power cord and turn the system on.
Wait for the system startup sequence to complete.
Verify that the touch screen is responsive and that system functions can be accessed.
If the issue persists, contact Stratasys Support.
